summary: 100% English is a Channel 4 television programme broadcast in November 2006 in the United Kingdom. It examined the genetic makeup of people who considered themselves ethnically English. While all participants had an ancestry profile similar to people of European descent, a minority showed genetic markers from North Africa and the Middle East from several generations back. The presenter was Andrew Graham-Dixon, and the results were interpreted by DNAPrint Genomics of Sarasota, Florida.
one_line: A 2006 Channel 4 documentary that tested the DNA of self-identified English people and found some with North African and Middle Eastern ancestry.
key_facts: 100% English is a Channel 4 television programme shown in November 2006 in the United Kingdom.
The programme looked at the genetic makeup of English people who considered themselves to be ethnically English.
All participants had an ethnic makeup similar to people of European descent.
A minority of participants discovered genetic markers from North Africa and the Middle East.
The genetic markers from North Africa and the Middle East were found from several generations before the participants were born.
The presenter of 100% English was Andrew Graham-Dixon.
The test results were interpreted by DNAPrint Genomics.
DNAPrint Genomics is based in Sarasota, Florida, United States.
